title: Observability: Add fencepost telemetry and contextual SLO clarifier
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: We observe a recurring source of slight double-counting and ambiguous phase attribution for long invocations where token cost/latency gets attributed to multiple phases (parse -> model -> postprocess). This PR introduces a lightweight 'fencepost' telemetry marker that explicitly bounds invocation phases, plus a contextual SLO clarifier that annotates alerts with burstiness-adjusted quiet-window recommendations.

What this changes (high level):
- Adds a fencepost marker API (server-side) that insertion points in the calling pipeline can emit to mark exact boundaries between phases; these markers are propagated to traces and metrics as fencepost_id and phase_boundary tags.
- Implements an SLO clarifier service that consumes rollups and recent invocation histograms to suggest per-tenant quiet-window and alert-weight overrides; suggestions are surfaced in the Console alerts UI and as annotation fields on SLO incidents.
- Dashboard: new compact panel (Observability > Invocation Boundaries) showing per-route fencepost hit-rates, phase-exclusive token distributions, and decile latency-by-phase.
- Alert tuning: the default SLO rule engine now consults clarifier suggestions (opt-in via feature flag) and can automatically apply a temporary quiet window when burstiness crosses configured thresholds.
- Sampling/tracing: small update to span enrichment to attach fencepost metadata; span sequence validation added to avoid stale fenceposts.

Checklist: 
- [x] fencepost API + server exporter (Go)
- [x] SLO clarifier (Python service) with feature flag gating
- [x] Console dashboard JSON and panel config
- [x] Unit + integration tests for fencepost logic and clarifier thresholds
- [x] Documentation updates and runbook snippet
- [x] Release notes entry

Commits (summary):
- feat(obsv): add fencepost marker interface and exporter (src/observability/fencepost.go)
- feat(slo-clarifier): initial clarifier service and decision API (services/slo_clarifier/main.py)
- perf(trace): attach fencepost tags during span emit and add sequence validation (pkg/tracing/enrich.go)
- ui(dashboards): invocation-boundaries panel and token-by-phase decile visualization (dashboards/invocation_boundaries.json)
- docs: observability/fencepost.md and runbook snippet
- test: unit + integration tests for clarifier heuristics (test/clarifier_test.py)

Files changed (high level):
- src/observability/fencepost.go: new API, exporter to telemetry pipeline
- pkg/tracing/enrich.go: span enrichment with fencepost tags + validation
- services/slo_clarifier/main.py: decision engine and HTTP suggestion API
- dashboards/invocation_boundaries.json: new dashboard panel (compact)
- docs/observability/fencepost.md: design doc and runbook
- test/clarifier_test.py: heuristics and integration mocks
- ci/integration/traces.yaml: added clarifier e2e job
- pkg/featureflags/flags.go: added gate for clarifier auto-apply

Behavioral notes: fencepost markers are intentionally lightweight (single key/value paired with a monotonic boundary sequence). The clarifier uses a short rolling window (default 10m) and computes a burstiness score based on Poisson-detrended token arrival variance; thresholds are conservative by default. All auto-apply behavior is opt-in per-tenant via a feature flag; we ship the suggestion-only mode by default.

Backward compatibility: all changes are additive. Existing tracing consumers ignore fencepost tags if unknown. The clarifier runs as a separate service and only affects alerting behavior when the feature flag is turned on per-tenant.

Deployment plan: feature-flagged rollout to canary tenants for 48h, monitor fencepost hit-rate and SLO suggestion churn; if stable, promote to 25% of tenants for 7d before full rollout.

Release notes (short): Add fencepost telemetry for precise phase attribution and a contextual SLO clarifier that proposes quiet-window and weight adjustments to reduce alert noise during bursts. Opt-in by default.

Related: ENG-2024 (observability long-tail attribution), ENG-2077 (alert-tuning playbook).
